info.name: Apache ZooKeeper Admin Server Cluster Watches API

items.docs: Returns brief information on watches. Equivalent to the 'wchs' four-letter-word command.

info.name: Apache ZooKeeper Get Watches by Connection

items.docs: Lists detailed information on watches by connection (session). Equivalent to the 'wchc' four-letter-word command.

info.name: Apache ZooKeeper Get Watches by Path

items.docs: Lists detailed information on watches by path. Equivalent to the 'wchp' four-letter-word command.
